_comment: Score thresholds below which an AI output is withheld (SRS FR-13, AIR-3). category: chosen on the dev split (386 courses) - at 0.20 the predictions withheld are only 47.5% correct while the 85% kept are 86.5% correct; higher values start withholding mostly-correct predictions. occupation 0.55 and skill/retrieval 0.45: measured with the real encoder, see docs/SPRINT_LOG.md (FR-3, FR-4).
